messages.text: Dear BrightHome Customer Service, I ordered an LED desk lamp with dimmer for $30.00 and paid via PayPal. The lamp arrived on Nov 8 with a cracked base. Since it arrived damaged, I am requesting a full refund of $30.00. Please advise on how to return the damaged item. Thank you.
